tactics: intro α i j l <;> induction j generalizing l <;> cases l <;> simp only [List.drop_nil, List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add, List.drop_succ_cons, Nat.succ_add, *]

intro α i j l <;> induction j generalizing l with | zero => simp only [List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add] | succ j ih => cases l with | nil => simp only [List.drop_nil] | cons a l => rw [show j + 1 + i = (j + i) + 1 by omega, List.drop_succ_cons, List.drop_succ_cons, ih]
